domains.title: Reference data & policy
domains.spec: Policy thresholds, Appendix E/F rubrics, journal rankings, lists, RAG

domains.title: Assessment, reports & decisions
domains.spec: Agents, Report Builder, HoD/Dean gates, Appendix D

domains.title: Researcher profiles & referees
domains.spec: Chancellor's Office Agent, worker, Appendix J/K

tables.name: app_user
tables.doc: A person who can log in. Identity fields feed Section 0 of the dossier (spec §4.1).
constraints: CHECK ck_app_user_credentials_match_provider: (auth_provider = 'local' AND password_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (auth_provider = 'oidc' AND external_subject IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: user_role
tables.doc:
One person can hold several roles (a Head of Department is also a professor).

HoD roles are scoped to a department, Dean roles to a college.
constraints: CHECK ck_user_role_hod_has_department: role <> 'hod' OR department_id IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_user_role_dean_has_college: role <> 'dean' OR college_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: auth_session
tables.doc: Login session. Only the SHA-256 of the token is stored; the raw token lives in the browser cookie.

tables.name: policy_version
tables.doc: A version of the governing policy. A case is judged by the version in force on its submission date.

tables.name: promotion_criteria
tables.doc: All numeric thresholds for one track under one policy version (conditions doc §1, §2, §6, §7).

tables.name: research_item_cap
tables.doc: Per-type caps for books and similar items (p.6), e.g. textbooks max 1.

tables.name: rubric
tables.doc: Appendix E (teaching, 30 pts) or Appendix F (service, 10 pts).

columns.name: pass_points
columns.note: a setting: service is 7 or 8 (open question)

tables.name: rubric_item
constraints: CHECK ck_rubric_item_points_range: min_points >= 0 AND max_points >= min_points

tables.name: journal_ranking
tables.doc: One SJR category ranking of a journal for one year. The A/B class is computed by rule, not stored.

tables.name: lookup_value
tables.doc: Admin-editable dropdown values (spec §15), e.g. list_code='committee_role', code='chair'.

tables.name: policy_chunk
tables.doc: A clause of the policy text for RAG: full-text search (tsv) + vector similarity (embedding).

tables.name: promotion_case
tables.doc: One application. Section 0 answers are stored here as a snapshot at submission time.
constraints: CHECK ck_promotion_case_rejection_needs_date: NOT previously_rejected OR rejection_date IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_promotion_case_exceptional_needs_justification: NOT exceptional_case OR exceptional_justification IS NOT NULL

tables.name: case_document
tables.doc:
Every uploaded file. Attached to one dossier entry (entity_table + entity_id) or to a whole section.

The (entity_table, entity_id) pair is a polymorphic link, validated in application code: one table
serves ~30 entry tables instead of 30 separate document tables.
constraints: CHECK ck_case_document_entity_pair: (entity_table IS NULL) = (entity_id IS NULL)

tables.name: degree
tables.doc: §3 – one academic degree (Appendix I, First).
constraints: CHECK ck_degree_study_period: study_to IS NULL OR study_to >= study_from

tables.name: rank_history
tables.doc: §4A – one academic rank held (Appendix I, Second). Drives time-in-rank.
constraints: CHECK ck_rank_history_held_period: held_to IS NULL OR held_to >= held_from

tables.name: non_academic_position
tables.doc: §4B – Appendix I, Third.

tables.name: scopus_evidence
tables.doc: §5F – metrics as entered by the applicant from their Scopus profile screenshot.

columns.name: screenshot_date
columns.note: must be within 30 days of submission (rule)

tables.name: recommendation_letter
tables.doc: §8 – optional letters (file in case_document).

tables.name: publication
tables.doc: §5A – one journal paper.
constraints: CHECK ck_publication_main_has_basis: applicant_role <> 'main' OR main_author_basis IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_publication_supervision_linked: NOT with_supervised_student OR supervision_id IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_publication_author_position_range: author_position BETWEEN 1 AND total_authors
CHECK ck_publication_published_has_issue_date: status <> 'published' OR issue_date IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_publication_other_explained: main_author_basis <> 'other' OR main_author_explanation IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_publication_accepted_has_date: status <> 'accepted' OR acceptance_date IS NOT NULL

tables.name: publication_author
tables.doc: Author list of a paper; used for the supervision rule and referee conflict-of-interest checks.

tables.name: coauthored_paper_evaluation
tables.doc: Appendix H row for a co-authored paper. PROVISIONAL: columns to be confirmed with the 5A template.

tables.name: journal_criteria_confirmation
tables.doc: §5E – policy §4 journal criteria, only for journals missing from the journal table.

tables.name: creative_work
tables.doc: §5A-2 – approved creative / studio work (Class B, capped).

tables.name: book
tables.doc: §5B – book or book chapter (per-type caps in research_item_cap).
constraints: CHECK ck_book_chapter_has_title: item_type <> 'chapter' OR chapter_title IS NOT NULL
CHECK ck_book_heritage_refereed: item_type <> 'heritage' OR referee_count IS NOT NULL

tables.name: conference_paper
tables.doc: §5C – recorded; not counted towards minimums unless the policy confirms (open question 7).

tables.name: funded_project
tables.doc: §5D – also linkable from §7B community service (scored once).

tables.name: patent
tables.doc: §5G – only granted patents count (Class B, capped).
constraints: CHECK ck_patent_granted_has_date: status <> 'granted' OR grant_date IS NOT NULL

tables.name: award
tables.doc: §5H – narrative only, not counted.

tables.name: course_taught
tables.doc: §6A – one course in one semester (Appendix I, Fifth A).

tables.name: peer_observation
tables.doc: §6B – Appendix E item 2.
constraints: CHECK ck_peer_observation_rating_in_scale: rating >= 0 AND rating <= scale_max

tables.name: student_satisfaction
tables.doc: §6C – Appendix E item 1. Respondents <= students is checked in application code (cross-table).
constraints: CHECK ck_student_satisfaction_score_in_scale: average_score >= 0 AND average_score <= scale_max

tables.name: curriculum_contribution
tables.doc: §6D – Appendix E item 6 (deep vs. mild judged by the Teaching Agent).

tables.name: advising_semester
tables.doc: §6E – Appendix E item 9. Counts only; no student names.

tables.name: course_file
tables.doc: §6F – Appendix E item 4.

tables.name: teaching_innovation
tables.doc: §6G – Appendix E items 7 (case studies) and 8 (educational technology).

tables.name: supervision
tables.doc: §6H – graduate supervision. Appendix E item 5 (Full only) and the research supervision rule.

columns.name: student_name
columns.note: sensitive: matching only, never sent to the LLM

constraints: CHECK ck_supervision_graduated_has_date: status <> 'graduated' OR graduation_date IS NOT NULL

tables.name: teaching_development
tables.doc: §6I – activities attended; Appendix E item 10.

tables.name: committee_membership
tables.doc: §7A-1 – Appendix F item 1 (required section).

tables.name: administrative_position
tables.doc: §7A-2 (optional) – mapped by the Service Agent to Appendix F item 1.

tables.name: workshop_delivered
tables.doc: §7A-3 (optional) – Appendix F item 4.

tables.name: training_delivered
tables.doc: §7A-4 (optional) – Appendix F item 3.

tables.name: policy_contribution
tables.doc: §7A-5 (optional) – mapped to Appendix F item 1.

tables.name: community_activity
tables.doc: §7B – mapped by the Service Agent to Appendix F items (there is no community line on the form).

tables.name: agent_run
tables.doc: One execution of a component on a case; kept for reproducibility (model, prompt version, input hash).

tables.name: agent_assessment
tables.doc: Result of one component run (formerly 'TierAssessment').

tables.name: criterion_result
tables.doc: One row of the report's summary table: criterion · required · actual · pass/fail.

tables.name: item_result
tables.doc: Per-entry verdict, e.g. paper #3: counted, Class A, credited as main author (by rule).

tables.name: claim
tables.doc: A factual statement in an agent's output and the records it cites; checked by verify_claims().

tables.name: flag
tables.doc: Anything a human must look at: mismatches, unverified claims, exceptional-case requests.

tables.name: rubric_score
tables.doc: One Appendix E/F line: agent suggestion, then HoD and Dean approval (spec §14.1).

columns.name: change_reason
columns.note: required (in app code) when approved != suggested

constraints: CHECK ck_rubric_score_non_negative: suggested_points >= 0 AND (hod_points IS NULL OR hod_points >= 0) AND (dean_points IS NULL OR dean_points >= 0)

tables.name: case_report
tables.doc: Output of the Report Builder; a new version after each revision cycle.

tables.name: gate_decision
tables.doc: A human approval gate (HoD, Dean). The Chancellor selects referees; that is not an approval.
constraints: CHECK ck_gate_decision_revision_names_sections: outcome <> 'return_for_revision' OR sections_to_revise IS NOT NULL

tables.name: dean_evaluation
tables.doc: Appendix D – Dean's Performance Evaluation Report (narratives pre-drafted by the agents).

tables.name: researcher_profile
tables.doc: Cached external profile of an applicant ("last synced" shown in the UI, refreshable).

tables.name: referee
tables.doc: An external referee. Identity is confidential: never shown to the applicant (permission rule).

tables.name: referee_candidate
tables.doc: Shortlist entry built by the Chancellor's Office Agent (max 10 per case, enforced in code).

tables.name: reviewer_assignment
tables.doc: A contacted referee. Doubles as the history for the 5-year non-reuse rule.

tables.name: outreach_message
tables.doc: Every email sent to a referee (invitation, reminder, ...), sent by the Reminder & Webhook Worker.

tables.name: referee_report
tables.doc: Appendix J/K – one returned report; the file itself is a case_document (kind=referee_report).

tables.name: referee_paper_grade
tables.doc: Each referee grades each counted paper (%). Averages and the top-three mean are computed by rule.

teaching_items: Effectiveness of teaching according to students' evaluations
Effectiveness of teaching according to peer evaluations of a sample of courses
Contribution to graduate studies (graduate courses and/or thesis supervision)
Developing study plans and programs, proposing or modifying courses
Case studies comparing the effectiveness of teaching methods
Seminars, workshops or conferences on improving teaching methods
service_items: Serving on department, college and university committees
Activities of local, regional and international academic and professional associations
Training and educational activities inside and outside the university
Organizing or lecturing in workshops and seminars of the department, college or university
Academic or professional consultation in the field of specialization
